title: MISP's EventDelegationsController delegateEvent method accepted a user-supplied sharing_group_id parameter without…
description: MISP's EventDelegationsController delegateEvent method improperly accepted a user-supplied sharing_group_id without verifying user membership in that group. Authenticated users with delegation permission could guess sharing group IDs and obtain the names of sharing groups outside their organization, including hidden or restricted groups. This vulnerability leads to limited confidentiality exposure of sharing group names but does not allow access to group contents or data modification.
